findings.fix: Spread the root's attributes (as Atom63Logo does), accept a `title`/aria override and ref; YZ may keep `colored` as is since the package is private.

findings.subject: @atom63/widgets WidgetStateFeedback
findings.summary: Carried from r2-k11-20: `atom63 docs pattern-widgets` prints a bare JSX fragment in the States section: the docs-to-Markdown export leaks a live example.
findings.evidence: `pnpm -s atom63 docs pattern-widgets` output contains `{['loading', 'empty', 'error'].map(state => (` followed by `))}` with nothing between.
findings.fix: Make the Markdown export replace JSX example blocks with their source (or drop them) the way other pages do; add a CLI test that no docs page contains raw JSX expressions.

findings.subject: @atom63/inform InformCornerFlyout
findings.summary: Carried from r2-k11-21: The flyout's exit always slides toward +X, so in a left-placed stack the card slides toward the centre, not the edge the comment promises.
findings.evidence: packages/inform/src/surfaces/inform-corner-flyout.css:32-35 `transform: translateX(var(--a63-space-4))` with no placement condition; placements -left exist (flyout-stack.tsx:6).
findings.fix: Negate the offset under `.a63-InformFlyoutStack[data-placement$='left']`.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx CodeBlock
findings.summary: Carried from r2-k11-22: Syntax colours switch by light/dark mode with `dark:` variants, not by theme, so a theme cannot restyle code; this is baselined debt.
findings.evidence: docs/design-system/audits/craft-baseline.json mode-branch entries for packages/mdx/src/blocks/code-block/code-block.tsx (x2 each); code-block.tsx:83,137.
findings.fix: Drive Shiki's dual palette from a token (e.g. --a63-code-token-* resolved per mode and theme) and drop the baseline entries.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx Timeline
findings.summary: Carried from r2-k11-23: Timeline dots paint --a63-text-primary as a background, a token used outside its role (baselined).
findings.evidence: docs/design-system/audits/craft-baseline.json: 'token-role | packages/mdx/src/blocks/timeline/timeline.css | background-color: var(--a63-text-primary)'.
findings.fix: Use a fill/indicator token for the dot and remove the baseline entry.

findings.subject: @atom63/brand Atom63Logo
findings.summary: Carried from r2-k11-24: The brand README says each logo is named 'ATOM63', but Atom63Logo's default accessible name is 'ATOM63 logo'.
findings.evidence: packages/brand/README.md ('Each logo is an image named "ATOM63"'); packages/brand/src/atom63-logo.tsx:14 `title = 'ATOM63 logo'`.
findings.fix: Change the default title to 'ATOM63' (matching AppLogo) or correct the README.

findings.subject: @atom63/inform InformSpotlight
findings.summary: Carried from r2-k11-25: The Phone story mounts two 'Target control' buttons (the meta decorator's and the story's), so its baseline shows a stray, dimmed duplicate control.
findings.evidence: packages/inform/src/surfaces/inform-spotlight.stories.tsx:17-33 (meta decorator button) and :66-79 (Phone decorator button); apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/inform-spotlight-phone-chromium-linux.png shows both.
findings.fix: Give Phone its own render without the meta decorator (or parameterise the decorator's target).

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx DocExample
findings.summary: Carried from r2-k11-26: DocExample's tablist name appends a hard-coded English 'example view'.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/doc-example/doc-example.tsx:156 `aria-label={titleString ? `${titleString} example view` : 'Component example view'}` while the tab and copy labels are props.
findings.fix: Add a `tablistLabel` prop with the current text as default.

findings.subject: All subjects in @atom63/mdx, @atom63/inform, @atom63/widgets
findings.summary: Carried from r2-k11-27: No story in these packages renders right-to-left, so mirroring is unverified (ui-react components have a RightToLeft story).
findings.evidence: No `dir="rtl"`/RightToLeft story in packages/{mdx,inform,widgets}/src; `atom63 component alert` lists a RightToLeft story.
findings.fix: Add one RTL story per package covering the blocks with directional layout (Timeline, Steps, ResourceList, Compare, ImageCompare, flyout stack, widget card header).

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx prose and blocks
findings.summary: Carried from r2-k11-28: MDX prose and blocks ignore compact density: they space with Tailwind --spacing utilities, which density does not change.
findings.evidence: packages/styles/src/contracts/environment.css:85-90 changes only --a63-space-unit under [data-a63-density='compact']; MDX blocks use Tailwind p-/gap- utilities (e.g. doc-example.tsx:46).
findings.fix: YZ decides whether long-form content follows density; if yes, map block spacing to --a63-space-*.

findings.subject: @atom63/mdx ResourceList
findings.summary: Carried from r2-k11-29: The ResourceList row divider is mixed to 4% of an already subtle border, so it is effectively invisible.
findings.evidence: packages/mdx/src/blocks/resource-list/resource-list.css:46 `background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--a63-border-subtle) 4%, transparent)`.
findings.fix: Use --a63-border-subtle directly (or a separator token), or remove the divider if spacing alone should separate rows.
